name: The Minted Eclipse
image_style: A striking 16:10 landscape wallpaper in hand-pulled reduction linocut with translucent mineral washes, embossed paper grain, uneven ink edges, and selective metallic pigment. The mood is nocturnal, historical, dryly comic, and tactile: a solemn old-world craft scene interrupted by an impeccably serious visitor. Use deep bottle-black, blue-charcoal, smoked parchment, oxidized copper, dull vermilion, and tiny mineral-teal glints. Keep the upper edge quiet and spacious, with detail concentrated in the lower two-thirds and a calm shadowed region for widgets. No lettering, logos, watermarks, borders, frames, or interface elements.
scene: A single 16:10 landscape wallpaper inside a late-medieval royal mint at night: timber beams, soot-dark stone, guarded doors, hanging scales, engraved dies, clipped coin blanks, and a small furnace casting copper light across the workshop. Historically dressed minters work with quiet concentration while Space Ghost stands at the lower-right bench in his recognizable muscular white costume, black hood and mask, yellow cape, and red power bands, solemnly inspecting one tiny coin through an enormous jeweler’s loupe. His cape is carefully folded away from the furnace, and the workers treat him as an awkward but respectful quality inspector. The Christian and chivalric historical atmosphere remains dignified and secular; the humor comes only from his extreme professionalism and absurd mismatch of scale. Leave a broad dark, nearly empty upper-left area for desktop widgets; no sacred parody, devotional attributes, text, or lettering.
